notes.title: Devil in the Capital is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
Another installment in the catalogue of RSK Entertainment comes to Steam! A series of gruesome murders lead detective Mohammad Afshar to uncover a much more sinister plot. Another great murder mystery to solve from RSK Entertainment! Get your copy today and take advantage of a 15% percent release discount, good for the first week of release! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/659490/Devil_In_The_Capital/
